key_points: LULU cut full-year revenue outlook on softer demand—sharp pullback in leggings and moderating Mainland China trends; a genuine guidance/thesis revision, not noise
Securities fraud lawsuit filed tied to a 17% stock drop and alleged misrepresentations about growth adds legal overhang and raises governance/credibility risk
Nike's weak China sales (-26%) and investor-day scrutiny reinforce sector-wide athletic wear demand softness, a negative read-across for LULU
Earnings-decline narrative building despite buybacks funded by FCF; buyback support is offset by deteriorating fundamentals
Offsetting positives (strong earnings-surprise history, valuation reset at ~$104) are secondary and unlikely to reverse the negative revision near term
